label: Hypothetical generic source stress scenario — entirely synthetic traffic/outcome cohorts and assumed rules; not employer facts or a forecast
entity_boundary: These scenario traffic opportunities, buyer-accepted outcomes and billable outcomes are separate from B2B partner prospect records. A prospect reply, handoff or onboarding is not treated as a billable event.
window: 30 hypothetical days; identical assumed observation window for both cohorts
billable_event: Synthetic contract-accepted tracked outcome; not an insurance sale or a confirmed employer billing rule
assumptions: All source names, volumes, rates, prices, refunds and costs are invented for a reversible sensitivity calculation. Shock values are user assumptions, not copied research estimates.
Acceptance rate applies to scenario traffic opportunities. Billable rate applies only to accepted scenario outcomes. Fractional results are expected values, not actual events.
The shock changes one source's opportunity volume and direct acquisition cost per opportunity. Acceptance rate, billable rate, prices and other per-unit costs remain fixed assumptions.
All modeled costs are variable. Fixed overhead, hosting and human review are outside this modeled cohort contribution; this is not total company profit.
Acquisition cost means disjoint source procurement/list licensing cost, excluding paid media. Media spend is a separate paid advertising cost. No cost is counted in both fields.
Refunds are contra-revenue, partner payout is a cost per billable outcome, and acquisition/media/inference/channel costs are separate costs per opportunity.
Inference and channel amounts are assumed scenario allocations, not actual model usage or provider charges. This calculation makes zero model or external adapter calls.
A missing required modeled cost or revenue component yields unavailable contribution. Unknown is not treated as zero. Mixed currencies are rejected; no exchange rate is assumed.
Concentration uses expected accepted-outcome counts across the two synthetic sources in the stated window; it does not measure employer channel concentration or AI-only attribution.
No outcome, revenue, AI recommendation or business survival is guaranteed by this scenario or the system architecture.
